client_policies.user_copy: Development requests are limited to reviewed scopes and configured test users.
Production requests are limited to scopes reviewed for this OAuth client.

scopes.implemented_feature: Connect the selected Google account to the correct Tinyhat owner.
operations: Read the stable Google account identifier
scopes.why_narrower_insufficient: OpenID is the minimum stable identifier needed to bind the returned Google account to the connection.
scopes.user_copy: Confirm which Google account you are connecting.
demo_steps: Start an identity-only connection and confirm the returned account belongs to the signed-in user.

scopes.implemented_feature: Display and target a connected Google account without exposing credentials.
scopes.why_narrower_insufficient: The account email is needed so users and agents can distinguish and target multiple connected accounts.
scopes.user_copy: See the email address of the Google account you connect.
demo_steps: Complete identity-only connection and show the connected account address in the account picker.

scopes.implemented_feature: Identify the connected Google account in Tinyhat account controls.
scopes.why_narrower_insufficient: Basic profile data helps distinguish connected accounts that otherwise have similar identifiers.
scopes.user_copy: See basic profile information for the Google account you connect.
demo_steps: Complete identity-only connection and confirm the connected account can be distinguished in account controls.

scopes.implemented_feature: Read messages, threads, and Gmail settings for summaries, search, inbox review, and account-aware guidance.
scopes.why_narrower_insufficient: Message bodies, thread metadata, and relevant account settings are needed for inbox search, summaries, and account-aware guidance; identity-only access cannot read Gmail.
scopes.user_copy: Read your Gmail messages, threads, and settings without changing them.
demo_steps: List recent messages, summarize one selected thread, and read one harmless Gmail setting without changing the account.

scopes.implemented_feature: Send an email after the user confirms the exact external write.
scopes.why_narrower_insufficient: Sending a confirmed message requires Gmail send authority; identity and read scopes cannot send mail.
scopes.user_copy: Send email from your Gmail account after you confirm the message.
demo_steps: Prepare a harmless test message, confirm the exact recipient and content, and send it.

scopes.implemented_feature: Create, edit, and delete drafts and send confirmed messages.
scopes.why_narrower_insufficient: The narrower send scope cannot create, edit, inspect, or delete drafts before a message is sent.
scopes.user_copy: Create and manage drafts and send email after confirmation; this does not manage your inbox.
demo_steps: Create a draft, update it, and show the draft without sending it.

scopes.implemented_feature: Create, rename, and delete Gmail label definitions.
scopes.why_narrower_insufficient: Creating and maintaining custom label definitions requires label write access; read-only Gmail access cannot do it.
scopes.user_copy: Manage label definitions; applying labels to messages requires Inbox Manager access.
demo_steps: Create a temporary label, rename it, and delete it after separate write confirmations.

scopes.implemented_feature: Read, draft, send, archive, label, and update mailbox state without permanent deletion.
operations: Move messages to or from trash
scopes.why_narrower_insufficient: Inbox workflows need one grant that can read messages and change message labels, archive state, and read status; the narrower Gmail scopes each omit part of that workflow.
scopes.user_copy: Read and manage your inbox, drafts, labels, and outgoing email; permanent deletion is not included.
demo_steps: Apply a temporary label to one selected message, archive it, and show the updated mailbox state.

scopes.implemented_feature: Read event details for schedules, briefs, and availability review.
scopes.why_narrower_insufficient: Event details are needed for schedule summaries and meeting preparation; identity-only access cannot read events.
scopes.user_copy: Read event details from your calendars without changing events.
demo_steps: List upcoming events and summarize one event without changing it.

scopes.implemented_feature: Read, create, update, and delete calendar events after write confirmation.
scopes.why_narrower_insufficient: The read-only event scope cannot create, update, or delete events for coordination workflows.
scopes.user_copy: Read and manage calendar events after you confirm each external change.
demo_steps: Create a temporary event, update its title, and delete it after separate confirmations.

scopes.implemented_feature: Create Drive files and read, update, or delete files Tinyhat creates or files the user explicitly shares with the app.
operations: Read files Tinyhat creates or the user explicitly shares with the app
Update files Tinyhat creates or the user explicitly shares with the app
Delete files Tinyhat creates or the user explicitly shares with the app
data_read: Files Tinyhat creates or files the user explicitly shares with the app
data_written: Files Tinyhat creates or files the user explicitly shares with the app
scopes.why_narrower_insufficient: Creating and maintaining files through Tinyhat requires file-scoped write access; read-only access cannot create or update them.
scopes.user_copy: Create files and work with files Tinyhat creates or files you explicitly share with the app; this does not grant access to other Drive files.
demo_steps: Create a test file, read it, update it, delete it, explicitly share an existing test file with the app and update it, then confirm another Drive file is not available.

scopes.implemented_feature: Find and read files throughout the connected Drive.
scopes.why_narrower_insufficient: Drive-wide search and reading must include existing files the user has not explicitly opened with Tinyhat; drive.file cannot provide that coverage.
scopes.user_copy: Find and read files throughout your connected Google Drive without changing them.
demo_steps: Search for a test document, read it, and confirm the document is unchanged.

scopes.implemented_feature: Not implemented; listed so requests receive an explicit review-required result.
scopes.why_narrower_insufficient: No narrower reviewed Tasks scope implements task-list management, and the feature itself is not yet implemented.
scopes.user_copy: Google Tasks access is known but is not yet approved for Tinyhat connections.
demo_steps: Request this scope and confirm Tinyhat returns review_required before creating OAuth state or an authorization button.

scopes.implemented_feature: Restore and describe historical grants; new connections use event-only read access instead.
scopes.why_narrower_insufficient: No new request is justified: this broader scope exists only to reconstruct historical grants, and new event reading uses calendar.events.readonly.
scopes.user_copy: This broader historical read scope is preserved for existing grants and cannot be requested for a new connection.
demo_steps: Load a saved legacy bundle and confirm its exact scope is displayed without launching a new request.

presets.user_copy: Read Gmail messages, threads, and settings, calendar events, and Drive files without changing them.
Prepare and manage Gmail drafts and send confirmed messages.
Read and manage Gmail messages, drafts, labels, and mailbox state.
